name: @tochii/osb-toolkit
description: osu! Storyboarding Toolkit provides useful tools for your storyboarding pipeline as SDKs in C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Rust, Python, and C++.

scripts.format: dbx fmt && yarn format:rust && yarn format:csharp
scripts.lint: dbx lint --fix && yarn lint:rust && yarn lint:csharp
scripts.lint:rust: yarn clean:rust:if-large && cargo fmt --all -- --check && tsx scripts/cargo.ts clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.lint:csharp: dotnet csharpier check packages/core/examples && dotnet run --project tools/csharp-lint -c Release -- packages/core/examples
scripts.build:native: yarn clean:rust:if-large && tsx scripts/cargo.ts build -p osb-native --release
scripts.test:csharp: tsx scripts/cargo.ts build -p osb-native --release && dotnet test bindings/csharp/tochiRes.osbTK.Native.Tests -c Release
scripts.test:sdk: tsx scripts/cargo.ts build -p osb-native --release && dotnet test bindings/csharp/tochiRes.osbTK.Tests -c Release
scripts.test:cpp: tsx scripts/cargo.ts build -p osb-native --release && powershell -NoProfile -File bindings/cpp/build.ps1
scripts.test:python: tsx scripts/cargo.ts build -p osb-native --release && python -m unittest discover -s bindings/python/tests -t bindings/python
scripts.test:go: tsx scripts/cargo.ts build -p osb-native --release && cd bindings/go && go test ./...
scripts.test:java: tsx scripts/cargo.ts build -p osb-native --release && mvn -B -f bindings/java/pom.xml test
scripts.test:bindings: yarn clean:rust:if-large && yarn test:csharp && yarn test:sdk && yarn test:cpp && yarn test:python && yarn test:go && yarn test:java && yarn test:wasm
